settings.heading: What is in the bottle, and why.
settings.text: Look up the actives, oils and gentle extras behind our formulas, from the sun filters to the hydrators.
settings.detail_text: A plant oil that softens dry patches and gives body products their silky slip. We use organic coconut oil and pair it with water-binding ingredients so skin does not feel greasy.

settings.name: Ceramides
settings.detail: Lipids that help the skin barrier hold in moisture

settings.name: Coconut oil
settings.detail: A silky plant oil for softness and slip

settings.name: Hyaluronic acid
settings.detail: A humectant that pulls water into the top layer of skin

settings.name: Mica
settings.detail: Mineral shimmer for a golden, lit look

settings.name: Sun filters
settings.detail: Absorb UV and are chosen to meet reef-protection rules

settings.name: Vitamin C
settings.detail: An antioxidant that supports a brighter, more even look

settings.label: Which families are excluded?
settings.text: Phthalates, sulfates, parabens, formaldehyde donors, synthetic dyes and aluminum salts are among the groups we avoid across the range.

settings.label: Is the full list public?
settings.text: Yes. The complete alphabetical list sits on this page and updates when our standard changes.

settings.label: Are your formulas vegan?
settings.text: Every formula is free of animal-derived ingredients and is never tested on animals.
